promises.summary: Introduce annual mandatory refresher training for CCTV operators on suspicious behaviour

promises.quote: The MPS accepts that the reviews of this case lacked sufficient rigour and detail and that the review process was not sufficiently comprehensive to identify all the potential learning arising from the police response.
promises.summary: Accepts review process lacked rigour and will improve independence.

promises.quote: We accept that the Probation Delivery Unit (PDU) responsible for Jordan McSweeney was understaffed at the time. Whilst at a national level, the staffing position of the Probation Service is improving, I acknowledge that raising staffing in this PDU to its full complement remains a significant challenge. Therefore, until such time as the situation improves, in this PDU and others with acute pressure remaining, staff will follow a Prioritisation Framework which we first implemented in January 2022
promises.summary: Implement Prioritisation Framework to manage staffing pressures

concerns.quote: The probation delivery unit responsible for the offender was understaffed at the time of relevant oversight
There were no systems in place devised to assist the staff working in these stretched circumstances
concerns.hazard: lack of support systems for stretched staff

concerns.quote: The understanding around risk assessment was poor, at all levels of staffing
Risk assessment training is not part of the mandatory training framework within the probation service
concerns.hazard: lack of mandatory risk assessment training

concerns.quote: There were no checks to ensure the provision of up to date and accurate risk assessments to partner agencies
concerns.hazard: inadequate risk assessment sharing with partners

concerns.quote: There was a lack of professional curiosity and a lack of sufficient probing into information relevant to risk
concerns.hazard: lack of professional curiosity in risk assessment

links.explanation: Both reports identify a lack of professional curiosity as a contributing factor. The later report adds that this also involves insufficient probing into risk-related information.
